description.zh: 云手机密钥对名称。取值可以由多个密钥对名称组成一个JSON数组，最多支持100对SSH密钥对，名称之间用半角逗号（,）隔开。
description.en: Cloud phone key pair name. The value can be a JSON array composed of multiple key pair names, supporting up to 100 SSH key pairs. Names are separated by commas (,).

title.zh: 删除指定的云手机密钥对
title.en: Delete specified cloud phone key pairs

descriptions.zh:
- 删除云手机密钥对后，您需要注意
    - 无法通过ListKeyPairs查询该云手机密钥对。
    - 若已有云手机实例绑定了该密钥对：阿里云不再为您保存该密钥对，但是实例可以正常使用该密钥对。
descriptions.en:
- After deleting cloud phone key pairs, note the following:
    - The deleted cloud phone key pairs cannot be queried through ListKeyPairs.
    - If cloud phone instances are already bound to the key pair, Alibaba Cloud will no longer retain the key pair for you, but the instances can continue to use the key pair normally.
